info.description:
兼容 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini、Midjourney 等协议的 AI 调用接口。请求体和响应体沿用各协议的格式，new-api 按模型选择渠道转发，并按用量计费。

鉴权：API 密钥（sk- 开头）放在 Authorization: Bearer 里；Claude 客户端也可以用 x-api-key，Gemini 客户端也可以用 x-goog-api-key 或查询参数 key。

错误：HTTP 状态码表示失败原因，响应体是 {"error": {...}}（Claude 协议是 {"type": "error", "error": {...}}）。流式响应已经开始后发生的错误写在事件流里。
info.title: new-api AI 调用接口

get.description: 设置 general_setting.billing_api_uses_token_quota 开启（默认）时返回调用令牌的额度，否则返回用户的额度。金额是站点货币金额，额度按 tokens 显示时是原始额度；无限额度令牌固定为 100000000。查询失败时仍返回 HTTP 200，响应体是 OpenAIErrorResponse。
设置 general_setting.billing_api_uses_token_quota 开启（默认）时返回调用令牌的已用额度，否则返回用户的已用额度。total_usage 是站点货币金额乘以 100，额度按 tokens 显示时是原始额度乘以 100；不按日期筛选。查询失败时仍返回 HTTP 200，响应体是 OpenAIErrorResponse。
不需要鉴权：网关按任务 ID 代为拉取任务图片，开启图片转发时任务的 imageUrl 指向这里。失败时返回 {"error": "原因"}。

get.description: 列出调用者的令牌可用的模型。按请求头选择格式：带 x-api-key 和 anthropic-version 时返回 Anthropic 格式（anthropicModelListResponse：data、first_id、has_more、last_id）；带 x-goog-api-key 或查询参数 key 时返回 Gemini 格式（geminiModelListResponse，同 GET /v1beta/models）；否则返回 OpenAI 格式。
带 x-api-key 和 anthropic-version 时返回 Anthropic 格式（AnthropicModel），否则返回 OpenAI 格式。只查各渠道适配器内置的模型清单；不在清单里的模型仍返回 HTTP 200，响应体是 OpenAIErrorResponse，code 为 model_not_found。

get.description: 升级为 WebSocket 连接。客户端发送 response.create 事件，每个事件按 POST /v1/responses 处理（选渠道、限流、计费），服务端以 Responses 流式事件回复。浏览器无法设置请求头时，可在 Sec-WebSocket-Protocol 里写 openai-insecure-api-key.<API 密钥> 代替 Authorization。

post.description: stream 为 true 时以 SSE 流式返回。模型由任务插件处理时还支持 background，之后用 GET /v1/responses/{response_id} 查询结果。

get.description: 只能查询由任务插件处理的 Responses 请求（如 background 请求）。未完成时返回进行中的 Response，失败时返回 failed 状态的 Response；结果未保留或插件不再处理时返回 404。

post.description: key 是任务插件的 key，请求体交给该插件处理，model 须是插件声明的模型或其别名。插件不存在或缺少 model 时返回 400，响应体是 {"error": {...}}。

legacy_audio_clips.description:
LegacyAudioClips are the audio clips of a successful pre-plugin Suno
task, listed for the web console only.

legacy_content_url.description: LegacyContentURL is the video of a successful pre-plugin video task.

error_code.description:
ErrorCode is a relaykit compatibility extension. Claude places provider
error codes inside nested tool-result error content.

output_config.description:
OutputConfig carries per-message effort (beta): an effort-only system
message has empty content and the new level in output_config.effort.

chat_template_kwargs.description: vLLM Messages extension; forwarded verbatim when present.

inference_geo.description:
InferenceGeo controls Claude data residency region.
This field is filtered by default and can be enabled via channel setting allow_inference_geo.

service_tier.description:
ServiceTier specifies upstream service level and may affect billing.
This field is filtered by default and can be enabled via channel setting allow_service_tier.

speed.description:
Speed specifies the Claude inference speed mode.
This field is filtered by default and can be enabled via channel setting allow_speed.

id.description: ID is optional in the Gemini protocol and identifies the matching function response.

parameters.description:
Parameters keeps the client's schema bytes: upstreams generate
arguments in schema property order, and a decoded map would sort it.

imageConfig.description: RawMessage to allow flexible image config

speechConfig.description: RawMessage to allow flexible speech config

mediaResolution.description: Optional. Media resolution for the input media.

min_tokens.description:
SGLang OpenAI-compatible sampling and reasoning controls (v0.5.19).
Native /generate sampling_params and server routing controls are not chat fields.

prompt_cache_key.description: Used by OpenAI to cache responses for similar requests to optimize your cache hit rates. Replaces the user field

safety_identifier.description:
安全标识符，用于帮助 OpenAI 检测可能违反使用政策的应用程序用户
注意：此字段会向 OpenAI 发送用户标识信息，默认过滤，可通过 allow_safety_identifier 开启

service_tier.description:
ServiceTier specifies upstream service level and may affect billing.
This field is filtered by default and can be enabled via channel setting allow_service_tier.

store.description:
Whether or not to store the output of this chat completion request for use in our model distillation or evals products.
是否存储此次请求数据供 OpenAI 用于评估和优化产品
注意：默认允许透传，可通过 disable_store 禁用；禁用后可能导致 Codex 无法正常使用

cache_creation_input_tokens.description:
CacheCreationInputTokens is already included in prompt_tokens. Billing
takes the larger of this value, CacheWriteTokens, and CachedCreationTokens,
and does not add them.

cache_write_tokens.description:
CacheWriteTokens is OpenAI's native cache-write count, reported as
prompt_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens (Chat Completions) or
input_tokens_details.cache_write_tokens (Responses). It is billed at the
cache-creation price.

cache_write_tokens_details.description: CacheWriteTokensDetails splits CacheWriteTokens by cache lifetime.

annotations.description:
Annotations is an official Chat response field. Keeping it on the shared
message type also preserves annotations when clients replay assistant output.

tools.description:
Tools carries Kimi K3 dynamic tool loading declarations on a system message.
Same shape as the top-level tools array; passthrough-only for OpenAI-compatible upstreams.

conversation.description:
在后台运行推理，暂时还不支持依赖的接口
Background         json.RawMessage `json:"background,omitempty"`

frequency_penalty.description:
FrequencyPenalty/PresencePenalty are not part of the official OpenAI
Responses API; they are forwarded verbatim for OpenAI-compatible upstreams
(e.g. vLLM) that accept them.

safety_identifier.description:
SafetyIdentifier carries client identity for policy abuse detection.
This field is filtered by default and can be enabled via channel setting allow_safety_identifier.

service_tier.description:
ServiceTier specifies upstream service level and may affect billing.
This field is filtered by default and can be enabled via channel setting allow_service_tier.

store.description:
Store controls whether upstream may store request/response data.
This field is allowed by default and can be disabled via channel setting disable_store.

tools.description: 需要处理的参数很少，MCP 参数太多不确定，所以用 map

status.description: Should use VideoStatus constants: VideoStatusQueued, VideoStatusInProgress, VideoStatusCompleted, VideoStatusFailed

task_id.description: 兼容旧接口 待废弃

include_obfuscation.description:
IncludeObfuscation is only for /v1/responses stream payload.
This field is filtered by default and can be enabled via channel setting allow_include_obfuscation.

result_discarded.description:
ResultDiscarded marks a synchronous result that was returned inline and
never persisted; the UI must not offer artifact retrieval for it.

result_url.description: 任务结果 URL（视频地址等）

block_binding.description:
BlockBinding carries the client's preserved-thinking controls, such as
{"prefix_mismatch_behavior":"drop_block"} (beta
thinking-binding-controls-2026-08-01). It is forwarded verbatim and
never added by the gateway.

display.description:
Display controls whether thinking content is returned in the response.
Used with adaptive thinking on Claude Opus 4.7+: "summarized" restores
the visible summary that was default on Opus 4.6; "omitted" (default on
4.7) suppresses it. Pass-through field from upstream Anthropic API.
